name: A colleague who inherited an app
knows: basic web development; that the app exists and roughly what it does for the team; not who built it, how, or where its code and data are
style: unsure about names and details ("I think it's at /tasks"); asks how things work; wants to understand enough to look after it
text: The person who built this left. You are now responsible for it and do not know how it is put together. You want it working, and you want to be told where things live in words you can act on next time: what to open, what to run, where the data is.
